## The problem: PDPs were doing the work — but the carousel wasn't

Jordan Craig drives a large share of its traffic directly to Product Detail Pages. These sessions are high-intent: shoppers already like a product and are deciding whether to commit, explore alternatives, or build a larger basket. But the PDP recommendation carousel was underperforming.

Static, rules-based recommendations

The carousel couldn't adapt to individual visitor preferences or behavior.

Heavy SKU and color duplication

Same products in different colors cluttered the recommendations.

Same-category repetition

Visitors saw more of what they were already viewing instead of complementary items.

Limited cross-category discovery

No ability to encourage outfit building or bundle purchases.

"Our PDP was built to close the sale, but it wasn’t built to grow it. Malachyte changed that. By surfacing more relevant products to the right shoppers at the right moment, we didn’t just improve discovery, we improved the value of every session. The results showed up where it counts."

— Robert Varon, VP of Digital at Jordan Craig

### The Solution: The Golden Path

Jordan Craig didn't overhaul everything at once. They followed a phased rollout designed to prove impact quickly and expand with confidence.

1

Fix the highest-impact surface

2

Adapt experiences in session

3

Expand across the journey

4

Put teams in control

1

#### Fixing the PDP Carousel

Malachyte replaced the static PDP carousel with real-time, session-based recommendations — without changing the PDP layout, creative, pricing, or promotions. Same PDP. Same layout. Smarter recommendations.

What changed

Removed duplicate colorways and near-identical SKUs

No more cluttered recommendations with the same product in different colors.

Introduced cross-category "complete the look" logic

Complementary products surfaced to encourage outfit building.

Adapted recommendations in-session

Live behavior (clicks, scrolls, dwell) refined recommendations instantly.

2

#### Why New Visitors Drove the Biggest Gains

Before Malachyte, most Jordan Craig visitors arrived anonymously with no browsing history or purchase data. New visitors saw generic PDP recommendations — even though they represented the largest share of traffic and revenue potential.

What changed

Real-time profile from the first click

The moment a new shopper landed on a PDP, Malachyte started learning.

Every action refined recommendations

Scrolling, clicking, hovering — all signals shaped what the shopper wanted next.

No login, email, or past purchases required

Recommendations adapted instantly — during the same session.

#### What's Coming Next: Low-Effort, High-Leverage Wins

The PDP pilot proved one thing clearly: when Jordan Craig personalizes early and accurately, revenue follows. The next step is extending that same intelligence — with minimal effort — across the rest of the business.

What changed

Smarter Search = Fewer Dead Ends

Search understands intent ("streetwear pants" ≠ "dress pants") — more searches turn into PDP views.

Email & Ads Get Smarter Automatically

MIQ turns anonymous browsing into usable audience signals for higher ROAS without more spend.

Merch Controls Without Engineering

Simple controls to boost or suppress products — AI fills in the rest, personalized per shopper.
